entries.heading: EFFECTIVE DATE
entries.text:
SEC. 2003. EFFECTIVE DATE.

    Titles XXI through XXVII and title XXIX shall take effect on the 
later of--
            (1) October 1, 2017; or
            (2) the date of the enactment of this Act.

                  TITLE XXI--ARMY MILITARY CONSTRUCTION
